interactions.description: Attempted to use changing-room/pool-access area; noted wet floor, dirty toilets, and lockers not working; others acted like it was normal.

entities_involved.description: others present/not bothered and acting like conditions were normal

interactions.description: Watched an extremely wide river from an arched bridge; observed weeds moving with a very fast current and hundreds of hammerhead sharks; either escaped the river or was about to jump in (unclear which).
Saw puddles containing fish that were too big for the puddles; no ponds/rivers in sight; felt stressed about rescuing them.
Discovered a hidden lower layer in a purchased house; initially elated, then realized it was filled with multiple baths/pools; random people were present; area was not clean; felt very stressed.

entities_involved.description: "random people" in the hidden lower layer

interactions.description: Recurring need to use extremely dirty toilets while on the way somewhere; toilets are full to the brim and spilling onto the floor; no one else is bothered.
